# V1.10.7

Section: Source

**V1.10.7** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on March 17th, 2024.

## V1.10.7

- Fix - reduced requirement of air for coal firebox to increase heating
- Fix - fixed issue where diesel air intake was not calculated correctly causing large air buffer
